scope: Bounded source review and executable regression evidence; not a complete security audit or production certification
reviewer_execution_boundary: Read-only reviewer inspected source and installed IdentityModel 8.19.2 behavior; did not independently run full build suites

findings_resolved.finding: Provided JsonWebKey cloning used diagnostic ToString instead of JSON
findings_resolved.resolution: Explicit public-field snapshot, rejecting incompatible declared algorithm/use/key_ops
findings_resolved.regression: provided public JWK snapshots and validates without diagnostic ToString parsing

findings_resolved.finding: Metadata RSA KeySize can be inflated by leading-zero padding on a weak modulus
findings_resolved.resolution: Bounded canonical modulus/exponent parsing and actual bit-length validation, also bounded EC curve/coordinate checks
findings_resolved.regression: metadata padded weak RSA modulus is rejected despite inflated KeySize

findings_resolved.finding: Default metadata issuer validation can supplement configured ValidIssuer
findings_resolved.regression: metadata cannot expand the exact configured token issuer

findings_resolved.finding: Sample constructing ambient HttpContextAccessor and setting HttpContext can clear shared AsyncLocal state under parallel resolvers
findings_resolved.resolution: Request-owned fixed accessor with actual gated A/B HTTP and GraphQL sibling coverage
findings_resolved.regression: parallel GraphQL sibling fields keep A and B request contexts isolated

root_execution: Exact committed Engine passed 55 AuthProfile and 37 TenantReadSet checks on both Windows and WSL, plus every existing component suite
limits: No blanket vulnerability absence claim, no real IdP lifecycle/durable provider/snapshot consistency proof; cross-profile key separation and host cookie/CSRF/session policy remain application responsibilities
